question: 9 月的成交总额是多少？
notes: 口径依据 R001/R002/R003：按 pay_time 归期，status in (paid,refunded)，取 orders.amount
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'

question: 9 月扣掉退款之后的净成交额是多少？
notes: R004：退款按订单支付时间归期扣减
reference_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'), r AS (SELECT SUM(rf.refund_amount) AS amt FROM refunds rf JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = rf.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01') SELECT ROUND((SELECT amt FROM g) - COALESCE((SELECT amt FROM r), 0), 2) AS net_gmv

question: 9 月每天的成交额分别是多少？

question: 9 月下单的订单里，最终完成支付的比例有多高？
